statements.t: “Customer interest built across our portfolio during the quarter, reflecting the value the market places on near-term power at a time when many projects face uncertainty.

Our 466 MW large-load request at Ward County received provisional Batch Zero Baseload Pathway (b) classification, which ERCOT reserves for projects that are not considered new because they have already achieved initial energization.
We continue to expect energization in late 2027 as ERCOT completes its final classification process in December.
We look forward to working with the new administration in Texas and continue to support responsible data center development that protects ratepayers and benefits our local communities.

1 Consists of 499 gross MW: (i) 377 gross MW of the 466 gross MW of provisional Baseload capacity at our Ward County site, expected to energize in late 2027, subject to remaining regulatory approvals and completion of utility infrastructure projects; (ii) 112 gross MW across our Midland sites, which are energized; and (iii) additional 10 gross MW at one of our Midland sites, expected to energize in 2027.
Since the end of the quarter, we have sold approximately 25% of our bitcoin for approximately $62 million in cash, ahead of our expected development ramp next year.
Given year-to-date results, the Company expects cryptocurrency mining revenue to meet or exceed the mid-point of its range below.

The Company has not reconciled its Adjusted EBITDA outlook to net income (loss), the most directly comparable GAAP financial measure, because the information necessary for such a reconciliation is not available without unreasonable effort.

In particular, the Company's provision for income taxes for 2026 cannot be reasonably predicted, as it depends on factors that remain uncertain, including changes in the fair values of cryptocurrency and warrant liabilities and their related tax effects, and could have a material effect on projected net income (loss).

We believe that the presentation of this non-GAAP financial measure will provide useful information to investors and analysts in assessing the Company’s financial performance by excluding non-cash depreciation expense which is representative of historical investments and which we do not believe is indicative of our current operating performance.

We may incur similar or unusual items in the future that could affect Adjusted EBITDA, and our presentation should not be construed as an inference that future results will be unaffected by such items.
There can be no assurance that we will not modify the presentation of Adjusted EBITDA in the future, and any modification may be material.

dropped.t: Accordingly, we have not reconciled our estimated Adjusted EBITDA outlook to its most directly comparable GAAP measure, as it is not available without unreasonable effort.

risks.t: the timing and outcome of ERCOT's audit and final classification process and other regulatory processes
changes in law or regulation, including as a result of upcoming changes in administration in Texas
the availability of power and completion of required utility infrastructure
development and construction delays, cost increases and equipment availability
the Company's ability to enter into customer arrangements and commercialize development opportunities on acceptable terms
the availability and cost of capital
volatility in the price of bitcoin and in the fair value of the Company's warrant liabilities

risks_dropped.t: the uncertainties related to market conditions
